summary: Goddess of wisdom, strategic warfare and crafts; guardian of Athens.

functions.function: Eyes; honoured at Sparta by Lycurgus after he lost an eye
functions.verification_note: Pausanias 3.18.2: Lycurgus founded the sanctuary after his eye was struck out.

functions.function: Invented the horse bridle and taught horse-taming

rejected.claim: Athena is the goddess of heirlooms
rejected.reason: No ancient or scholarly source found; nearest real matches are Zeus Ktesios (household property) and Athena Phratria (family clans).
